# EnergyBar

The 10-segment energy meter (sn-energy): segments fill indigo to amber, with gaps after 4 and 7 marking the Low, Building and High tiers.

`SongNodes.EnergyBar` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.EnergyBar value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.EnergyBar" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (EnergyBarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `number \| null \| undefined` | Energy 1–10; null or undefined renders the unknown state. |
| `size` | `"row" \| "lg"` | "row" for tables (default), "lg" for detail views (adds the tier label). |
| `target` | `number` | Set target for this slot; outlines that segment and shows "target N". |
| `needsCheck` | `boolean` | Energy is an estimate that needs a listen; shows the "Check" flag. |
